title: Sato
text: 1. Sāvatthiyaṃ || || 2. Sato bhikkhave bhikkhu vihareyya || ayam vo amhākam anusāsanī || || 3. Kathañca bhikkhave {bhikkhu} sato hoti || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sato hoti || || 4. Sato bhikkhave bhikkhu vihareyya || ayaṃ vo amhākam anusāsanī ti || ||
